text:
Maya Chen: infra alert — spot_interruption_rate spike in us-west1-gpu, dashboard shows ~65% of spot pools with >3 interruptions/hr. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/spot/availability (screenshot attached)
InfraBot: ALERT: spot-availability sensor triggered (region=us-west1-gpu, severity=high). Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/spot-availability
Liam O'Connor: seeing same. Any evidence of a network flap or is this pure capacity reclaim? logs show eviction-scorer churn but not network errors.
Sophie Patel: tagging SLOs — affected routes: /generate and /chat-stream. Early signs of error-budget burn ~5% over last 30m on critical routes.
Raj Malhotra: quick telemetry peek: interruption bursts line up with a large preemptible batch job rollout from partner-tenant "data-ingest-x" starting ~16:12 UTC. Autoscaler filled many spot pools, then eviction events increased.
Maya Chen: rough mitigation plan: 1) throttle offending batch jobs, 2) engage regional failover for critical routes, 3) lower alert threshold sensitivity to avoid noise. Who can throttle the tenant job group?
Nate Kim: us-east has ~180 GPUs spare in Dedicated pool but tail latency cost would rise ~+35% if we shift heavy traffic. We have capacity but cost/latency trade-offs.
Sophie Patel: can we enable temporary sticky KV-cache routing + increase prewarmed instances for /chat-stream to mask cold starts while we failover? That will reduce request amplification.
Liam O'Connor: I'll open a quick PR to add an automated runbook step to throttle batch labels and to escalate to page if sustained. Adding suggested alert rules below:

alert_rule:
  name: spot_pool_interruption_rate
  expr: >-
    sum by(region) (rate(spot_interruptions_total[5m]) > 0)
    / count by(region) (spot_pools_total) * 100
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Spot interruption % by region"

# paging rule (high severity)
alert_rule:
  name: spot_pool_interruption_rate_critical
  expr: >-
    (sum by(region) (rate(spot_interruptions_total[5m]) > 0) / count by(region) (spot_pools_total)) * 100 > 50
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page

Maya Chen: propose we add a 2-tier sensor and a queued automatic fallback: after 3 consecutive 5m windows over 50% interruption -> trigger regional-fallback policy on critical routes (not all traffic). Put a soft cooldown to avoid oscillation.
Raj Malhotra: confirmed: throttling the partner's batch jobs reduced interruptions in a staging pool by ~70% in a canary run. We should add a label-based throttle API call: /ops/batch-throttle.sh --label data-ingest-x --rate 0.3
Liam O'Connor: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4523 -> updates alert thresholds and runbook steps to call batch-throttle and run capacity-check. Will also wire to INC tool for auto-ticketing.
InfraBot: Action logged: incident INC-20260318-72 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall (Liam O'Connor). Notifying #eng-oncall and #product (briefing).
Maya Chen: noted cost impact: spot churn seems to have increased inference unit cost by ~12% over the last 2 hours (more retries + fallback to Dedicated). We'll capture cost delta in the postmortem.
Sophie Patel: adding postmortem owner: @Sophie Patel; will export metrics (interruptions, pool counts, SLO burn, cost) and schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Nate Kim: ack. I can prep capacity plan for short-term failover (us-east) and estimate added infra cost.
Liam O'Connor: quick checklist I'm executing now: 1) throttle batch label, 2) increase prewarm for chat-stream, 3) verify KV cache stickiness, 4) enable regional-fallback for critical routes (gradual). Will report status in ~10m.
Maya Chen: thanks all :thumbsup: keep updates here. If paging fires again, escalate to infra-sre rota.
